patch_resolves_note: The staged fix patch applies cleanly to the ARVO workspace checkout. On the original PoC, the fixed build still reaches the post-increment guard with `offset_after_entry=512` and `offset_plus_header_size=524`, but it no longer executes `marshal_followup_header_read`; the adjacent `data_size_488_boundary` perturbation is the closest source-grounded witness that restores room for one `NV_RAM_HEADER` (`offset_plus_header_size=512 <= array_size=512`) and genuinely executes the follow-up header read in both versions.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `offset += nrh.size;` advances over one orderly entry, `INDEX_ORDERLY_RAM_Marshal()` must stop unless another full `NV_RAM_HEADER` still fits in `array`. When `offset + sizeof(NV_RAM_HEADER) > array_size`, the next loop iteration must not re-read a header from `array + offset`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the post-increment state with `offset_after_entry=512` and `offset_plus_header_size=524` against `array_size=512`, yet still performs the next header read. The fixed original records the same violating predicate but guards the protected read away, and the `data_size_488_boundary` case supplies the genuine witness where the predicate holds exactly at the boundary (`512 <= 512`) and the follow-up header read executes.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: Required-assertion status is `violated` on the vulnerable original, `guarded` on the fixed original, and `genuine` on the fixed `data_size_488_boundary` perturbation.

nodes.state: At the crashing follow-up header read, `nrhp = array + offset` points exactly to the end of the 512-byte orderly-RAM image, so `memcpy(&nrh, nrhp, sizeof(nrh.size))` begins at the one-past-end boundary.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `marshal_followup_header_read.read_offset == marshal_followup_header_read.array_size == 512`.

edges.relation: The same `offset` value produced by the post-increment step is carried unchanged into the next loop iteration and reused as the follow-up header read offset.
edges.evidence: The trace records `marshal_post_increment_guard.offset_after_entry == marshal_followup_header_read.read_offset` on both the vulnerable original (512) and the `data_size_488_boundary` witness (500).
